title: Privacy | Alai Labs
description: How Alai Labs handles the information you send through this website.

head.p_1: What this website collects, why, and how to reach us about it.

section1.p_1: Draft for review. The Alai team's legal adviser should confirm this notice, including which privacy laws it is written for in Singapore, the United States and India, before the site goes live.
section1.p_2: This website is run by Alai Labs Pte Ltd, 10 Ubi Crescent, #04-17 Ubi Techpark, Lobby B, Singapore 408564. You can reach us at info@alai-labs.com.
section1.p_3: We collect only what you type into the Request a demo form: your name, work email, organisation, country, industry if you choose one, and your message.
section1.p_4: This website does not use analytics, advertising trackers or tracking cookies.
section1.p_5: We use your details only to reply to your request and arrange a demo. We do not sell them or use them for unrelated marketing.
section1.p_6: Form submissions pass through a form service that delivers them to us by email.
section1.p_7: Name of the form service, where it stores data, and who at Alai receives requests. To be supplied once the service is chosen.
section1.p_8: How long requests are kept. To be supplied by the Alai team.
section1.p_9: You can ask us to show you, correct or delete the details you sent by emailing info@alai-labs.com.
